entities.summary: Sarah Omotunde Alade is a Nigerian economist. She was acting governor of the Central Bank of Nigeria during the suspension of Sanusi Lamido Sanusi. She was appointed to the post by president Goodluck Jonathan on 20th of February 2014. She held this position until the appointment of Godwin Emefiele in June 2014. She served as deputy governor, Central Bank of Nigeria from 26 March 2007 to 22 March 2017.
